actual_review.method: Viewed consecutive source-bound PNGs in six labeled analysis contact sheets, plus 33 actual full-resolution originals. This is advancing-frame visual inspection; no claim of audio listening or real-time game feel.

accepted_findings.finding: Rifle lowers independently; open hand follows the already accepted seed flight and retracts through the bottom of frame. The older probe still showed a hand at frame75 before it vanished at76; the final outgoing fingers exit the bottom before grip restoration at79. Q authority remains immediate; this does not represent a new throw windup.

Open palm and local rings remain readable against the placed patterned ward. Hand withdraws below view before support restores at101. Ward appears on acceptance before the full hand raise; no placement delay is claimed.
Curled digits create a distinct brace during the continuous lateral move. The restrained ground ring no longer dominates the lower frame. Hand clears view before grip restoration at113.

Charged palm rises before the first paced beam, remains visible through all three releases and withdraws fully before the normal support grip restores at148. The second receiver visibly falls after the second hit; third shot still releases.
Actual traces at 132/135/139 have visible absent intervals at 134/138, keeping three releases legible.

Primary trace/hit response, lowered reload with magazine travel, return to ordinary hold and central ADS remain present. Ammo changes24→21 then24/69. No cast-related firearm regression is visible in this bounded rehearsal.

preserved_rejected_evidence.reason: Previous cast hand vanished while still visible and the support grip appeared elsewhere. Old originals, analysis sheets and rejected runtime sources remain unchanged.

remaining_limits: Normal support sleeve/grip returns in one frame after the cast hand is off screen. The accepted correction is withdrawal before a discrete grip reset, not a continuous anatomical regrip.

Hands are stylized procedural geometry; palm shape, digits, ordinary support cuff and close contact remain simpler than a finished skinned first-person rig. This does not qualify complete full-body hero art.

This is one scripted 90-degree hip / 64.8-degree ADS camera rehearsal with staged credits, receivers, disabled bot decisions and a staged six-point ultimate resource. It is not ordinary OS-input or naturally earned-ultimate evidence.
The film is silent; no audio listening, physical-GPU performance, online integration or human game-feel acceptance is claimed.
